scientific_integrity: The full theorem is symbolic; the included exact-integer checks are finite corroboration, not infinite certification. The result is a short arithmetic consequence of published modular data, with possible unindexed prior equivalents.
scientific_limitations: Binary valuations and one further 2-adic unit layer of the level-13 four-term sequence only; no odd-prime or higher-unit characterization. Depends on the published level-13 modular identity.
title: Exact binary-digit valuations and denominators for the level-13 Apéry-like sequence
